echo "=== API with token approach: get auth via password changed ==="
COOKIE=/tmp/op4.txt; rm -f $COOKIE
curl -s -c $COOKIE http://localhost:8080/login -o /tmp/lp2.html
TOKEN=$(grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' /tmp/lp2.html | tail -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
# Follow the forced password change
curl -s -b $COOKIE -c $COOKIE -o /tmp/cp.html -w "change-form HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/my/password/edit"
grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' /tmp/cp.html | tail -1
